name: The Westin Tokyo
accessSummary: To Yebisu Garden Place: 5 min walk from JR Yamanote Line Ebisu Station East Exit (via the moving walkway "Ebisu Skywalk"), or 7 min walk from Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line Ebisu Station Exit 1. The hotel is adjacent to Yebisu Garden Place. By car, the Tengenji Ramp of the Metropolitan Expressway is convenient.

ops.parking: The on-site hotel parking lot costs 1,200 yen per hour. Valet parking is 2,000 yen per day. There is an electric vehicle charging station. If you pay 3,000 yen or more at a restaurant, parking is free for up to 3 hours, and the parking fee for hotel guests is 3,000 yen per day. The parking lot of the neighboring Yebisu Garden Place is open 7:00-24:00, at 400 yen per 30 minutes, with a maximum charge of 4,000 yen for 7:00-24:00 and 1,600 yen for 24:00-7:00 the next day. Vehicles must be no more than 2.1 m high, 6.0 m long and 2.05 m wide, and no more than 4.0 t in weight. The entrances are on the north side (in front of the Sapporo Breweries headquarters) and the east side (in front of The Westin Tokyo). The Garden Place parking service is not offered at The Westin Tokyo. (Source: Marriott hotel overview, Yebisu Garden Place access and parking guide)
ops.catering: The Marriott meetings and events page lists the per-person catering prices. Afternoon break 4,150 yen, coffee break 4,150 yen, continental breakfast 2,500 yen, full breakfast 3,500 yen, lunch 12,000 yen, dinner 30,000 yen, reception 6,000 yen.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has 8 restaurants and bars. The Terrace (1F, international), Ryutenmon (Cantonese, with private dining), Mai (Japanese), Teppanyaki "Yebisu" (top floor), The Lounge, The Bar, Sky Bar "Escalier", and Patisserie by The Westin Tokyo.
